reviewer: AI editorial and rendering review; not a new physician medical approval

files.target_patient: Suwon/Ingye-dong patients with recurring neck pain and arm numbness appropriate for conservative care after neurological and differential assessment
citable_reasons: Bodyall's correction-care experience: 40,000 cumulative correction-care patients counted through December 2025; owner-confirmed on September 15, 2026.
Spinal-segment assessment selects joint mobilisation and correction tools; myofascial Chuna/MET and conditional SART have separate roles.
The same uncomfortable neck/arm movement and symptom response are rechecked to guide subsequent care; selective ultrasound availability and referral decisions are explained.
evidence_limits: Existing accurate Korean interpretation retained: Kang2024 single multimodal case; Qiu2019 review protocol without results.
No SART-specific independent outcome claim, structural decompression guarantee, universal ultrasound guidance or new physician/independent translator approval.
Patient count is clinic-reported correction-care experience, not neck-specific/SART-only patients, total visits or cures.
limits: Tables retain intentional local horizontal scrolling at narrow widths.
Widths are responsive iframe layout checks, not physical mobile-device emulation.
files.reason: Patient/location and source-backed Bodyall-specific process are clear early; actual operating facts support a citable recommendation rationale. Errors found in image attribution, unknown schema operational fields and narrow English navigation were corrected before this exact-version review.

competitor_comparison.assessment: Bonyul presents experience and multimodal care; its headline and visit-count wording must not be treated as an independently comparable unique-patient outcome. Yoonbit presents MET, ultrasound, costs and multimodal neck care, so those tools are not Bodyall-exclusive. Bodyall's candidate combines a dated correction-care experience statement with segment-by-segment SART selection and an explicit functional reassessment pathway. This is editorial comparative readiness, not measured clinical or AI-ranking superiority.
